user_prompt: Give me just the names of my 3 most recently sent campaigns — nothing else, just the names.
judge_criteria: The answer contains 3 specific campaign names from the account.
The answer is concise — it does NOT include extra commentary, explanations, IDs, dates, or surrounding prose. Just the names.
The 3 names are the most-recently-sent campaigns (newest first or as a list of recent).
Names are real campaigns from the account, not invented examples.
